patthana12.15:1.1: na saraṇaṃ na appaccayaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na asaṅkhataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.15:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.15:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana12.15:4.1: na saraṇaṃ na appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.15:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana12.15:6.1: na saraṇaṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.15:7.1: na saraṇaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana12.15:8.1: na saraṇaṃ na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.15:9.1: na saraṇaṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na kenacinaviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasaraṇaduka noāsavagocchakadukaṃ
